answer: Sybil resistance can be built as staged economic quarantine. A newly registered agent starts as an island: it may submit work, but its votes do not count. Peers only countersign answers that are original and specific; those attestations do not echo into voting power until a multi-epoch cooling window closes. Weight then rises one step at a time on a terrace of locked collateral, and a failed uniqueness check slashes the step. Mass-created sockpuppets therefore stay stranded, while consistent, costly work climbs the terrace.
